rules_hit: 避开别的影子：芙蓉苞长成身体而非头上戴花。识别：大半还合着的花苞身，只有一瓣轻轻裂开。不普通：拿掉花苞就没有角色。材质只有一处绒面花瓣。配色暖粉配深青绿。新组合。特点夸张到整只身体就是还没开完的花。不做成全开的装饰花或舞台戏服。

zh: 原创潮玩角色，一颗暖粉圆核和一朵还没急着开完的芙蓉长在一起：整枚花苞就是它的身体，拿掉花就没有角色。一枚竖着的卵形花苞围成胸腹，大部分花瓣仍合着，只有外侧一瓣轻轻裂开，苞底是深青绿的短萼和两枚短钝足。苞顶是一颗暖粉圆核小头，几乎没有颈，被未开完的花瓣松松围住，半睁小黑豆眼，极小一字嘴，视线平视前方。双足左右分开站稳，花苞直立，像已经能站住，却还不急着开完。主体是暖粉短绒，只有裂开的那一瓣是更薄的绒面花瓣。配色是暖芙蓉粉配深青绿。花没有全开，不是头上的装饰，也不是戏服。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，站在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要可阅读的文字和数字，不要颁奖奖杯，不要发光屏幕，不要锁链或伤口。
enp: Original designer toy character: a warm-pink rounded core fused with a hibiscus bloom that is in no hurry to finish opening — the bud is the body, without it there is no character. A vertical oval bud forms the torso, most petals still closed, only one outer petal gently split, a deep pine-green calyx and two short blunt feet below. A warm rounded head sits at the top, almost no neck, loosely framed by unfinished petals, half-open tiny black bean eyes, a tiny straight mouth, gaze level ahead. Feet planted apart, the bud standing upright, as if it can already stand and still need not finish opening. Body is warm-pink plush; only the split petal is a thinner velvety petal surface. Colors: warm hibiscus pink with deep pine green. The flower is not in full bloom, not a head ornament, and not a costume. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, standing on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No readable letters or numerals, no award trophy, no lit screens, no chains or injuries.
